"""Preserve actual architecture readiness and original live-owner evidence."""
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json');assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'paired-control':10,'harmonic-context':10}
assert smoke['exact_V160_control_trace_rows']==10
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
finite=0
for arm in state['arms']:
    expected=state['arms'][arm]['parameter_tensors']
    assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==expected
    assert all(float(s['step'])==10 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ['models','emas'] for v in state[key][arm].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values())
    finite+=expected
assert finite==91 and all(min(v.values())>0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl';assert not snapshot.exists()
with (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').open() as stream:lines=[next(stream) for _ in range(40)]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in lines];baseline=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for index,row in enumerate(rows):
    old=baseline[index];assert row['step']==old['step'] and row['batch']==old['batch'] and row['domain']==old['domain']
    assert row['arms']['paired-control']==old['arms']['paired-response']
snapshot.write_text(''.join(lines))
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');poststatus=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='running-declared-phase' and status['phase']=='train'
assert poststatus['status']=='waiting-for-original-training-owner'
owners=[]
for role,owner in [('training-controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('review-controller',poststatus['owner'])]:
    p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01 and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
    owners.append({'role':role,**owner,'argv':p.cmdline(),'status':p.status()})
live_snapshot=root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json';assert not live_snapshot.exists()
save(live_snapshot,{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training':status,'postprocess':poststatus,
    'progress':read(root/'train-progress-v1.json'),'observed_live_owners':owners,
    'scope':'Historical actual live snapshot,not final quality or final call totals. Both original workers continue once.'})
ready=root/'readiness-audit-v1.json';assert not ready.exists()
save(ready,{'status':'pass-actual-restored-smoke-and-exact-control-prefix','smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),
    'finite_Adam_states_at10':91,'all91_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,
    'exact_V160_control_prefix_rows':40,'training_prefix':ref(snapshot),
    'smoke_peak_CUDA_bytes':smoke['CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes'],'new_neural_forwards':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
dest=repo/'docs/results/v161-harmonic-context-preparation-v1';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names={'plan.json':'plan-v1.json','quality-design.json':'quality-design-v1.json','CPU-readiness.json':'CPU-readiness-v1.json',
    'parity.json':'parity-result-v1.json','smoke.json':'smoke-result-v1.json','readiness-audit.json':'readiness-audit-v1.json',
    'training-prefix.jsonl':snapshot.name,'live-snapshot.json':live_snapshot.name,
    'postprocess-imports.json':'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json','postprocess-plan.json':'postprocess-plan-v1.json',
    'retained-native-comparators.json':'native-retained-comparators-v1.json'}
copies={}
for name,source in names.items():
    p=root/source;q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes()
    copies[name]={'original':ref(p),'public':ref(q)}
paths=list((Path(plan['work'])/'scripts').glob('*.py'))+list((Path(plan['work'])/'configs').glob('*'))
paths+=list((root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'))
paths += [repo/p for p in ['src/demosaic/late_harmonic_context.py','tests/test_late_harmonic_context.py',
    'tests/test_late_spatial_rgb.py','tests/test_regional_dc_objective.py','tests/test_local_excess_risk.py',
    'tests/test_delivered_spectral_objective.py','tests/test_robust_spectral_objective.py',
    'tests/test_paired_response_objective.py','tests/test_paired_response_data.py','tests/test_coupled_sensor_noise.py',
    'tests/test_paired_response_counters.py','tests/test_paired_response_batch_isolation.py',
    'scripts/train_harmonic_context_trial.py','scripts/review_harmonic_context_trial.py','scripts/diagnose_harmonic_context_trial.py',
    'configs/quality-v143-harmonic-context-v161.yaml','.cache/build-v161-controller-v1.py','.cache/build-v161-review-v1.py',
    '.cache/launch-v161-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v161-postprocess-v1.py','.cache/queue-v161-review-v1.py']]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
previous=read(Path(plan['previous'])/'plan-v2.json')
neural={p:h for p,h in previous['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==87
for p,h in neural.items():
    assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=dest/'source-bundle-v1.json'
save(bundle,{'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],
    'unchanged_prior_neural_hashes':neural,'new_module':ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_harmonic_context.py'),
    'publisher':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
index=repo/'docs/results/v161-harmonic-context-preparation-v1.json';assert not index.exists()
save(index,{'status':'ready-original-training-live-quality-pending','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'copies':copies,'sources':ref(bundle),'source_texts':len(paths),'unchanged_prior_neural_sources':87,'new_neural_modules':1,
    'parameters':{'control':117677,'candidate':124397,'increment':6720},'parameter_tensors':{'control':45,'candidate':46},
    'actual_CPU_tests':139,'new_context_checks':16,'compatibility_contexts':28,'compatibility_head_calls':56,
    'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,'finite_Adam_states_after_restored_smoke':91,'exact_V160_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'fixed_heads':2,'fixed_endpoints':4,'steps_per_head':1000,'review_cases':822,'planned_review_calls':3288,
    'planned_context_removal_calls':48,'fixed_context_removal_cases':12,'planned_total_scientific_head_calls_excluding_tests':5412,
    'planned_new_prediction_arrays':1668,'planned_native_images':72,'planned_triplets':24,'retained_native_columns':5,
    'planned_native_RGB_channels':50764800,'quality_complete':False,'performance_native_viewing_complete':False,
    'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_calls':0,'original_lookups':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'scope':plan['scope']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published',len(names),'exact receipts,',len(paths),'source texts;87 old neural sources unchanged/one new module;3 owners live')
